title: ReactorFusion Compound-v2 fork (zkSync Era + Telos) — live extraction audit
headline_note: E-U is dust liquidation bonuses: ~$1.77 gross on zkSync Era + ~$0.50 gross on Telos. Era gas (~0.045 gwei, ~250-400k gas per liquidation = $0.03-0.10) eats most of it: net Era $0.0-0.5, net Telos $0.3-0.5 -> net total ~$0.5 (range $0.1-1.0). The protocol's $283k cash is NOT reachable by an unprivileged attacker today.

categories_note.E-U: liquidation bonus on genuinely underwater positions, NET of estimated gas: Era ~$1.77 gross -> $0.0-0.5 net; Telos ~$0.50 gross -> $0.3-0.5 net
categories_note.H-O: suppliers' self-service redemptions: Era cash $282,709.92 + Telos cash $615.10 (suppliers' full claim is $394.6k Era; the rest is borrowed out)
categories_note.P: admin/timelock/EOA can upgrade cTokens (delegate `_setImplementation`), swap oracle, take reserves — privileged, not quantified
categories_note.S: unliquidatable bad debt (Era shortfall with zero collateral ≈ $222 + Telos uncovered ≈ $8) — a supplier loss, not attacker gain

live_cash_usd.note: at DefiLlama market prices 2026-10-14; at oracle prices Era cash = $290,245

closed_reasons: Era oracle is a live Chainlink latestAnswer() reader (5 feeds updated within hours at read time) — no stale-price borrow-and-default
no market is deprecated (cf>0, borrow not paused, reserveFactor != 1e18) — healthy positions cannot be liquidated
liquidations are permissionless but the live underwater set is dust (largest realistic single profit $0.096); the two largest shortfalls have zero collateral (LIQUIDATE_SEIZE_TOO_MUCH revert)
admin paths (oracle swap, comptroller/cToken upgrade, takeReserves, _reduceReserves, reserve factor, pause) are timelock- or admin-gated; attacker calls revert or return non-zero error
RewardDistributor holds 0 ETH/USDC/USDT/WBTC; fresh-account harvest returns 0; RF (ES33) token is unpriced/unlisted
Telos oracle (DIA) can only be written by DIA's updater EOA; stale 7.5-8.3 days but not manipulable; Telos closeFactor=1.0 but profit is dust

poc.tests_note: poc/test/ReactorFusionMath.t.sol 6/6 pass (fork-free). poc/test/ReactorFusionLive.t.sol self-skips (standard Foundry cannot execute EraVM bytecode; probe documented). Executable PoC = ci/live_verify.py live-node eth_call verification + state-override liquidation simulation.

key_facts: ReactorFusion is a Compound v2 fork, wind-down announced; no exploit ever reported (analysis/incident-research.md)
fork emits Borrow/RepayBorrow/LiquidateBorrow from the Comptroller (cTokens emit none) — borrower enumeration must use txs
Era cash: 84.15 ETH ($205.5k) + 11.5k USDC.e + 17.5k USDT + 0.1475 WBTC + 2.19M ZK + 2.9k USDC = $282.7k at market prices
Era oracle: SimplePriceOracle = feed.latestAnswer()*10**(36-feedDec-cTokenDec) with NO staleness check; feeds live (ETH/USD updated ~30 min before read)

Era admin = OZ TimelockController 0xeE568575A8DaeF55D2fac121FD2362dF6BbB5Db5 (minDelay 86400s); oracle owner and rfZK/rfUSDCz cToken admin = EOA 0x99999A3C4cB8427c44294Ad36895b6a3A047060d (also Telos admin)
realistic Era liquidation profit: $1.77 across 59 accounts (largest $0.096), recomputed with protocolSeizeShare 2.8% and oracle-vs-market gaps
Telos: DIA oracle stale 7.5-8.3 days, updater-only writes; 13 underwater accounts, ~$0.50 profit; cash $615
caveats: The Era liquidation total is bounded by the collateral found in the phase-2 account scan (1,863 accounts read; 1,497 with positions; top-1200 collateral holders per market). The rfETH market's debt attribution was incomplete ($69k); a gap crawl re-enumerates borrowers in the missing block ranges (analysis/era-crawl/) and a targeted live check of the largest net-principal borrowers was run (analysis/era-crawl-candidates.json). Unattributed debt without collateral is bad debt (S), not E-U.
USD uses DefiLlama spot prices at 2026-10-14; gas estimates approximate.

The oracle has no freshness guard: if Chainlink retires any zkSync feed, the borrow-and-default/liquidation conditions re-open (thresholds: cf 0.85 -> >17.6% overvaluation; liquidation profiteering -> >~8% collateral undervaluation).
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract only ~$2.3 (dust liquidation bonuses) from ReactorFusion's ~$283k live cash: the Era oracle is a live Chainlink reader with no staleness guard but fresh feeds, borrow-and-default is unprofitable at live collateral factors, no market is deprecated, admin/upgrade/reserve paths are timelock- or admin-gated, and the reward distributor is empty.
